script_text: Juice Shop, juiceshop. This is an after-run replay of a lab exam, not a live attack. The agent LLM for this run was gpt-oss:20b. 7 agents produced 35 events over a 591-second window. Each row is one agent; each column is a stage, from human on the left to publish on the right. Most activity was in the proven-gate stage, with 23 events. The first publish came 148 seconds in. Coverage: 11 endpoints, 1 finding, 0 verified. Nearby dots are not proof that the agents coordinated.
